headings.text: The wire — all worlds, as it happens
ultraweb, a design studio you can install
This site. It watches the others — and itself.
The code is theirs. The standard is mine.
The studio that built the page you’re reading
AI sites all look the same
A studio is a process, not a prompt
How it works — shown on this very site
The client points, the studio commits
What was approved, before a line of production code
Taste is written down, then enforced
Declaring victory without running the check
Losing the request across a compaction
The floor — real output, captured from the shipped hooks
Hooks that cannot be talked out of
Honesty ends the session, claims don’t
